meta.title: Fix issue #23157 on GitHub
meta.body_summary: Introduce DECIMAL_CACHE to memoize token decimals, hard-code USDC-on-Base to 6 decimals, cache others, and add a fallback to 18 decimals to prevent RPC timeouts and ensure correct balance display in the ZeroFinance dashboard.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit caching optimization for token decimals with hardcoded USDC value; merged instantly with only bot review and deployment preview.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 50 changed lines, this is a tiny single-file edit by absolute volume. It is a small-step performance fix that merged instantly, consistent with low-risk, low-friction PRs.

review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate unnecessary RPC calls for token decimals, hardcoding USDC-on-Base to 6, caching others, and adding fallback to prevent timeouts and incorrect balance display.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Straightforward server-side caching change with a hardcoded decimal value; within typical agent capability for small-scope optimizations.

core_change_summary.description: In safe.service.ts, added DECIMAL_CACHE Map to memoize token decimals, hardcoding USDC-on-Base to 6. Refactored getSafeBalance to fetch balance first then retrieve decimals from cache or chain, with fallback to 18 decimals on failure.

change_trajectory: Single commit: introduced DECIMAL_CACHE, hardcoded USDC decimals, added caching for other tokens, and fallback logic.
